response.sql: WITH pair_averages AS (SELECT f.orderslink, u.acctscope, AVG(f.feerate) AS average_fee_rate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY f.orderslink, u.acctscope), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(average_fee_rate) AS mean_pair_average FROM pair_averages), ranked AS (SELECT p.orderslink, p.acctscope, p.average_fee_rate, p.average_fee_rate - m.mean_pair_average AS excess, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.acctscope ORDER BY p.average_fee_rate - m.mean_pair_average DESC, p.orderslink) AS pair_rank FROM pair_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS m WHERE p.average_fee_rate > m.mean_pair_average) SELECT orderslink, acctscope, average_fee_rate, excess, pair_rank FROM ranked WHERE pair_rank <= 3 ORDER BY acctscope, pair_rank
